```{r}

migrations <- read_csv(migrations_file, show_col_types = FALSE)
migrations
```

```{r}
# --- Aggregate directed flows -----------------------------------------
flows_direct <- migrations %>%
  group_by(country_from, country_to) %>%
  summarise(direct_migrants = sum(num_migrants, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

flows_direct
```

```{r}
# --- Make undirected pairs and compute chosen aggregation -------------
agg_method <- "sum"    # options: "sum","mean","max","difference","ratio"

flows_undir <- flows_direct %>%
  filter(country_from != country_to) %>%
  mutate(pair_a = pmin(country_from, country_to),
         pair_b = pmax(country_from, country_to)) %>%
  group_by(pair_a, pair_b) %>%
  summarise(
    sum_ab = sum(direct_migrants, na.rm = TRUE),
    dir_ab = sum(direct_migrants[country_from == pair_a & country_to == pair_b], na.rm = TRUE),
    dir_ba = sum(direct_migrants[country_from == pair_b & country_to == pair_a], na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    total_migrants = case_when(
      agg_method == "sum"        ~ dir_ab + dir_ba,
      agg_method == "mean"       ~ rowMeans(cbind(dir_ab, dir_ba), na.rm = TRUE),
      agg_method == "max"        ~ pmax(dir_ab, dir_ba, na.rm = TRUE),
      agg_method == "difference" ~ (dir_ab - dir_ba),
      agg_method == "ratio"      ~ if_else(dir_ba == 0, NA_real_, dir_ab / dir_ba),
      TRUE ~ dir_ab + dir_ba
    )
  ) %>%
  rename(country1 = pair_a, country2 = pair_b)

flows_undir
```


```{r}
# threshold <- 150000    # change threshold or use top-N logic later
threshold <- 15000    # change threshold or use top-N logic later

# --- 4) Filter by threshold (you can swap to top-N/quantile instead) -----
if (agg_method %in% c("difference")) {
  flows_undir <- flows_undir %>% filter(abs(total_migrants) > threshold)
} else if (agg_method %in% c("ratio")) {
  flows_undir <- flows_undir %>% filter(is.finite(total_migrants) & total_migrants > threshold)
} else {
  flows_undir <- flows_undir %>% filter(total_migrants > threshold)
}

# If nothing remains after filtering, lower threshold or change selection
if (nrow(flows_undir) == 0) stop("No flows left after filtering — lower threshold or change selection.")

flows_undir
```

```{r}
  left_join(Country_region_clean %>% select(alpha2, region, sub_region),
```

```{r}
# ---- Compute per-country totals for node sizing -----------------------
country_totals <- bind_rows(
  flows_undir_region %>% select(country = country1, total_migrants),
  flows_undir_region %>% select(country = country2, total_migrants)
) %>%
  group_by(country) %>%
  summarise(total_migration = sum(total_migrants, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
country_totals
```


```{r}
# --- Build vertices (attach region + size) ----------------------------
vertices <- tibble(name = unique(c(edges_df$from, edges_df$to))) %>%
  left_join(Country_region_clean %>% select(alpha2, region, sub_region), by = c("name" = "alpha2")) %>%
  rename(region = region, sub_region = sub_region) %>%
  left_join(country_totals, by = c("name" = "country")) %>%
  mutate(
    total_migration = replace_na(total_migration, 0),
    value = total_migration + 1,               # +1 avoids zero sizes (tweak as desired)
    # group = if_else(is.na(region), "Unknown", region)
    group = if_else(is.na(region), "Unknown", sub_region)
  )

# compute circular label angles in the exact order defined by edges_df (so regions are contiguous)
vertices$id <- NA_integer_
myleaves <- which(is.na(match(vertices$name, edges_df$from)))
nleaves <- length(myleaves)
vertices$id[myleaves] <- seq_len(nleaves)
vertices$angle <- 90 - 360 * vertices$id / nleaves
vertices$hjust <- ifelse(vertices$angle < -90, 1, 0)
vertices$angle <- ifelse(vertices$angle < -90, vertices$angle + 180, vertices$angle)

```


```{r}
# --- Graph layout and connection geometry -----------------------------
mygraph <- igraph::graph_from_data_frame(edges_df, vertices = vertices)
layout <- create_layout(mygraph, layout = "dendrogram", circular = TRUE)

# Map flows to vertex ids AND keep only valid mappings
from_ids <- match(flows_undir_region$country1, vertices$name)
to_ids   <- match(flows_undir_region$country2, vertices$name)
valid <- !is.na(from_ids) & !is.na(to_ids)

from_ids <- from_ids[valid]
to_ids   <- to_ids[valid]
flows_sel <- flows_undir_region[valid, ]

# get_con returns a function that needs layout — call it to produce geometry rows
con_fun <- ggraph::get_con(from = from_ids, to = to_ids)
con_df  <- con_fun(layout)
con_df <- con_df %>% mutate(con.id = as.integer(con.id))

```


```{r}
# ---  Attach per-connection attributes (width/alpha) -------------------
conn_attribs <- tibble(
  con.id = seq_len(nrow(flows_sel)),
  scaled_width = scales::rescale(flows_sel$total_migrants, to = c(0.3, 2)),
  scaled_alpha = scales::rescale(flows_sel$total_migrants, to = c(0.15, 0.95))
)
con_df <- left_join(con_df, conn_attribs, by = "con.id")

# join country & region info for the connection (for edge colouring)
conn_summary_full <- flows_sel %>%
  mutate(con.id = seq_len(n())) %>%
  select(con.id, country1, country2, region1, region2, total_migrants)

con_df <- left_join(con_df, conn_summary_full, by = "con.id") %>%
  mutate(shared_region = if_else(region1 == region2 & !is.na(region1), region1, "Inter-regional"))

```

## same line width
```{r}
#  Main plot: no legends, semi-transparent node circles
p <- ggraph(mygraph, layout = 'dendrogram', circular = TRUE) + 

  # bundles: gradient colouring kept as in your example
  geom_conn_bundle(
    data = get_con(from = from_ids, to = to_ids),
    aes(colour = after_stat(index)),
    alpha = 0.20,    # slightly lighter bundles
    width = 0.9,
    tension = 0.8,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_edge_colour_distiller(palette = "RdPu") +

  # labels, coloured by subregion (group) but no legend
  geom_node_text(
    aes(x = x * 1.18, y = y * 1.18, filter = leaf, label = name, angle = angle, hjust = hjust, colour = group),
    size = 4, alpha = 1, show.legend = FALSE
  ) +

  # nodes: slightly transparent (alpha < 1), no legend for points
  geom_node_point(
    aes(filter = leaf, x = x * 1.08, y = y * 1.08, colour = group, size = value),
    alpha = 0.6, show.legend = FALSE
  ) +

  # use the named Paired palette (same as example style)
  scale_colour_manual(values = pal_nodes, na.value = "grey70") +

  # node size scale (bigger circles) — adjust range if you want even larger
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(2, 15), trans = "sqrt") +

  # remove legends entirely from theme
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.margin = unit(c(0, 0, 0, 0), "cm")
  ) +
  expand_limits(x = c(-1.45, 1.45), y = c(-1.45, 1.45))

# print to screen
print(p)

# 3) Save the main figure (png + pdf)
ggsave("migration_network_by_subregion_nolegend.png", plot = p, width = 10, height = 10, dpi = 300)
# ggsave("migration_network_by_subregion_nolegend.pdf", plot = p, width = 10, height = 10)

# 4) Save a subregion -> colour mapping as CSV (useful reference)
mapping_df <- tibble(subregion = names(pal_nodes), colour = unname(pal_nodes))
# write_csv(mapping_df, "subregion_colors.csv")

# 5) Create and save a compact legend image (subregion dots + labels)
#    This renders a simple vertical legend you can keep alongside the figure.
legend_df <- mapping_df %>% mutate(y = row_number())

legend_plot <- ggplot(legend_df, aes(x = 1, y = -y)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = subregion), size = 5,  alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_text(aes(label = subregion), hjust = 0, nudge_x = 0.15, size = 3) +
  scale_color_manual(values = setNames(legend_df$colour, legend_df$subregion)) +
  xlim(1, 2.5) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        plot.margin = margin(10, 10, 10, 10))

# ggsave("subregion_legend.png", plot = legend_plot, width = 4, height = max(4, 0.25 * nrow(legend_df)), dpi = 300)
```

## by line width
```{r}
#  Create con_df with total_migrants included
con_fun <- ggraph::get_con(from = from_ids, to = to_ids)
con_df  <- con_fun(create_layout(mygraph, layout = "dendrogram", circular = TRUE)) %>%
  mutate(con.id = as.integer(con.id)) %>%
  left_join(
    flows_sel %>% mutate(con.id = seq_len(n())) %>% select(con.id, total_migrants),
    by = "con.id"
  )

# 2️⃣ Plot: variable line thickness by total_migrants
ggraph(mygraph, layout = 'dendrogram', circular = TRUE) + 
  geom_conn_bundle(
    data = con_df,
    aes(edge_colour = ..index.., edge_width = total_migrants),  # width ~ flow strength
    alpha = 0.25,
    tension = 0.8
  ) +
  scale_edge_colour_distiller(palette = "RdPu") +
  scale_edge_width_continuous(range = c(0.2, 7)) +   # adjust contrast here
  geom_node_point(
    aes(filter = leaf, x = x*1.08, y = y*1.08, colour = group, size = value),
    alpha = 0.6, show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_node_text(
    aes(x = x*1.18, y = y*1.18, filter = leaf, label = name, angle = angle, hjust = hjust, colour = group),
    size = 7, alpha = 1, show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = pal_nodes, na.value = "grey70") +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(2, 15), trans = "sqrt") +
  theme_void() +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  expand_limits(x = c(-1.45, 1.45), y = c(-1.45, 1.45))

ggsave("Result/migration_sub_m.png", width = 10, height = 10, dpi = 300)
```

```{r}
# build a named discrete palette for node groups (subregions)
groups <- unique(na.omit(vertices$group))
n_groups <- length(groups)
pal_nodes <- rep(brewer.pal(9, "Paired"), length.out = n_groups)
names(pal_nodes) <- groups
# add fallback for any missing names and ensure "Unknown" exists
if (!"Unknown" %in% names(pal_nodes)) pal_nodes <- c(pal_nodes, "Unknown" = "grey70")

# Choose node size scaling range (bigger circles)
size_range <- c(2, 15)

# If you are using 'value' in vertices as node size, ensure it's available:
# (vertices$value was created earlier; otherwise compute per-country totals)

# Now the plot
ggraph(mygraph, layout = 'dendrogram', circular = TRUE) + 

  # bundles: evaluate get_con() inline (ggraph will call it), colour by internal index for a gradient
  geom_conn_bundle(
    data = get_con(from = from_ids, to = to_ids),
    aes(colour = ..index..),
    alpha = 0.25,         # visibility of bundles
    width = 0.9,
    tension = 0.8
  ) +
  scale_edge_colour_distiller(palette = "RdPu") +   # continuous colour for bundles

  # leaf labels pushed further out; coloured by subregion (group)
  geom_node_text(
    aes(x = x * 1.18, y = y * 1.18, filter = leaf, label = name, angle = angle, hjust = hjust, colour = group),
    size = 2.4, alpha = 1
  ) +

  # leaf points slightly inside, coloured by subregion, size ~ value
  geom_node_point(
    aes(filter = leaf, x = x * 1.08, y = y * 1.08, colour = group, size = value),
    alpha = 0.9, show.legend = TRUE
  ) +

  # discrete node colours (subregions)
  scale_colour_manual(values = pal_nodes, na.value = "grey70") +

  # node size scale (tweak range to make circles larger/smaller)
  scale_size_continuous(range = size_range, trans = "sqrt") +

  theme_void() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    plot.margin = unit(c(0, 0, 0, 0), "cm")
  ) +
  expand_limits(x = c(-1.45, 1.45), y = c(-1.45, 1.45))
```

```{r}
# Libraries
library(ggraph)
library(igraph)
library(tidyverse)
library(RColorBrewer)
```

```{r}
migrations <- read.csv("/Users/wenlanzhang/Downloads/PhD_UCL/Data/Oxford/Migration/international_migration_flow.csv")
# migrations

flows_direct <- migrations %>%
  group_by(country_from, country_to) %>%
  summarise(direct_migrants = sum(num_migrants, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
flows_direct
```

```{r}
agg_method <- "sum"     # one of: "sum", "mean", "max", "difference", "ratio"

flows_undir <- flows_direct %>%
  # drop self-links (if you don't want self edges)
  filter(country_from != country_to) %>%
  mutate(
    pair_a = pmin(country_from, country_to),
    pair_b = pmax(country_from, country_to)
  ) %>%
  group_by(pair_a, pair_b) %>%
  summarise(
    # compute both directions' sums (if one direction missing, treat as 0)
    sum_ab = sum(direct_migrants, na.rm = TRUE), # note: this sum includes both directions already, but we show options below
    # We'll collect the two directed contributions separately to allow more options:
    dir_ab = sum(direct_migrants[country_from == pair_a & country_to == pair_b], na.rm = TRUE),
    dir_ba = sum(direct_migrants[country_from == pair_b & country_to == pair_a], na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    # aggregated weight according to the chosen method
    total_migrants = case_when(
      agg_method == "sum"        ~ dir_ab + dir_ba,
      agg_method == "mean" ~ rowMeans(cbind(dir_ab, dir_ba), na.rm = TRUE),
      agg_method == "max" ~ pmax(dir_ab, dir_ba, na.rm = TRUE),
      agg_method == "difference" ~ (dir_ab - dir_ba),    # signed: positive means more from pair_a -> pair_b
      agg_method == "ratio"      ~ if_else(dir_ba == 0, NA_real_, dir_ab / dir_ba),
      TRUE ~ (dir_ab + dir_ba)   # fallback to sum
    )
  ) %>%
  # keep the original country labels for plotting edges
  rename(country1 = pair_a, country2 = pair_b)

flows_undir
```

```{r}
threshold  <- 100000         # keep only undirected pairs whose aggregated weight > threshold

if (agg_method %in% c("difference")) {
  # maybe threshold by absolute difference:
  flows_undir <- flows_undir %>% filter(abs(total_migrants) > threshold)
} else if (agg_method %in% c("ratio")) {
  # ratio may contain NA (division by zero). Filter only finite ratios:
  flows_undir <- flows_undir %>% filter(is.finite(total_migrants) & total_migrants > threshold)
} else {
  flows_undir <- flows_undir %>% filter(total_migrants > threshold)
}
```

```{r}
pal <- rep(brewer.pal(9, "Paired"), length.out = length(vertices$name))

# scale widths between 0.3 and 2 (example); scale alpha between 0.15 and 0.95
con_summary_vals <- flows_undir$total_migrants
scaled_width <- scales::rescale(con_summary_vals, to = c(0.3, 2))
scaled_alpha <- scales::rescale(con_summary_vals, to = c(0.15, 0.95))

  geom_node_point(aes(filter = leaf, x = x * 1.07, y = y * 1.07, colour = name, size = value), show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("root" = "black", pal)) +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(1, 6)) +
  geom_node_text(aes(x = x * 1.12, y = y * 1.12, filter = leaf, label = name, angle = angle, hjust = hjust),
                 size = 3, show.legend = FALSE) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(legend.position = "none", plot.margin = unit(c(0, 0, 0, 0), "cm")) +
  expand_limits(x = c(-1.3, 1.3), y = c(-1.3, 1.3))

print(p)
```

```{r}
ggsave("migration_network_undirected.png", plot = p, width = 8, height = 8, dpi = 300)

```


# Sample data
```{r}
# create a data frame giving the hierarchical structure of your individuals
set.seed(1234)
d1 <- data.frame(from="origin", to=paste("group", seq(1,10), sep=""))
d2 <- data.frame(from=rep(d1$to, each=10), to=paste("subgroup", seq(1,100), sep="_"))
edges <- rbind(d1, d2)
 
# create a dataframe with connection between leaves (individuals)
all_leaves <- paste("subgroup", seq(1,100), sep="_")
connect <- rbind( 
  data.frame( from=sample(all_leaves, 100, replace=T) , to=sample(all_leaves, 100, replace=T)), 
  data.frame( from=sample(head(all_leaves), 30, replace=T) , to=sample( tail(all_leaves), 30, replace=T)), 
  data.frame( from=sample(all_leaves[25:30], 30, replace=T) , to=sample( all_leaves[55:60], 30, replace=T)), 
  data.frame( from=sample(all_leaves[75:80], 30, replace=T) , to=sample( all_leaves[55:60], 30, replace=T)) )
connect$value <- runif(nrow(connect))
 
# create a vertices data.frame. One line per object of our hierarchy
vertices  <-  data.frame(
  name = unique(c(as.character(edges$from), as.character(edges$to))) , 
  value = runif(111)
) 
# Let's add a column with the group of each name. It will be useful later to color points
vertices$group  <-  edges$from[ match( vertices$name, edges$to ) ]

vertices
```


```{r}
#Let's add information concerning the label we are going to add: angle, horizontal adjustement and potential flip
#calculate the ANGLE of the labels
vertices$id <- NA
myleaves <- which(is.na( match(vertices$name, edges$from) ))
nleaves <- length(myleaves)
vertices$id[ myleaves ] <- seq(1:nleaves)
vertices$angle <- 90 - 360 * vertices$id / nleaves
 
# calculate the alignment of labels: right or left
# If I am on the left part of the plot, my labels have currently an angle < -90
vertices$hjust <- ifelse( vertices$angle < -90, 1, 0)
 
# flip angle BY to make them readable
vertices$angle <- ifelse(vertices$angle < -90, vertices$angle+180, vertices$angle)

vertices
```


```{r}
# Create a graph object
mygraph <- igraph::graph_from_data_frame( edges, vertices=vertices )
 
# The connection object must refer to the ids of the leaves:
from  <-  match( connect$from, vertices$name)
to  <-  match( connect$to, vertices$name)
 
# Basic usual argument
ggraph(mygraph, layout = 'dendrogram', circular = TRUE) + 
  geom_node_point(aes(filter = leaf, x = x*1.05, y=y*1.05)) +
  geom_conn_bundle(data = get_con(from = from, to = to), alpha=0.2, colour="skyblue", width=0.9) +
  geom_node_text(aes(x = x*1.1, y=y*1.1, filter = leaf, label=name, angle = angle, hjust=hjust), size=1.5, alpha=1) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    legend.position="none",
    plot.margin=unit(c(0,0,0,0),"cm"),
  ) +
  expand_limits(x = c(-1.2, 1.2), y = c(-1.2, 1.2))
```


```{r}
ggraph(mygraph, layout = 'dendrogram', circular = TRUE) + 
  geom_conn_bundle(data = get_con(from = from, to = to), alpha=0.2, width=0.9, aes(colour=..index..)) +
  scale_edge_colour_distiller(palette = "RdPu") +
  
  geom_node_text(aes(x = x*1.15, y=y*1.15, filter = leaf, label=name, angle = angle, hjust=hjust, colour=group), size=2, alpha=1) +
  
  geom_node_point(aes(filter = leaf, x = x*1.07, y=y*1.07, colour=group, size=value, alpha=0.2)) +
  scale_colour_manual(values= rep( brewer.pal(9,"Paired") , 30)) +
  scale_size_continuous( range = c(0.1,10) ) +
  
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    legend.position="none",
    plot.margin=unit(c(0,0,0,0),"cm"),
  ) +
  expand_limits(x = c(-1.3, 1.3), y = c(-1.3, 1.3))
```
